title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2607.05369v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, recent advances in agentic coding systems have potential to combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies. We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. translated_title: GaP：一种用于变分自动化任务的“图即策略”多智能体自学习框架
translated_abstract: 要让机器人在商业和工业应用中可靠地工作，智能体编码系统的最新进展有潜力将可解释的机器人编程与无模型策略的开放世界适应能力相结合。我们专注于“变分自动化”（VA），这是一类在物体几何形状和姿态上的变化比固定自动化更大的任务。无模型策略往往难以缩小变分自动化任务的可靠性差距，而这些任务在商业和工业应用中必须持久且可靠地执行。受先前任务与运动规划（TAMP）和机器人操作系统（ROS）方面工作的启发，我们提出了“图即策略”，这是一个多智能体编码框架，能够从模块化开源机器人技能库（MORSL）中生成包含感知、规划和控制节点的有向计算图。GaP生成一个内部仿真环境，以便用不同的图并行地排练任务实例。
tldr: 本文提出了Graph-as-Policy（GaP），一个多智能体自学习编码框架，它从模块化开源机器人技能库生成包含感知、规划和控制节点的有向计算图，并利用内部仿真环境进行排练，从而提升物体几何与姿态变化较大的变分自动化任务的可靠性。
en_tdlr: GaP is a multi-agent self-learning coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library, leveraging an internal simulation environment to close the reliability gap for Variational Automation tasks.
